sources.title: October 2025: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
sources.evidence_location: official HTML overview and October 2025 contract-data section
facts: The page is the October 2025 monthly Project Gigabit management-information release
BDUK publishes contracted and built premises by contract
The collection page records it as the first monthly publication in the series
The page was updated on 19 June 2026
limitations: Monthly management information is not live retail orderability
Contract totals cannot be assigned to an individual parcel

sources.title: November 2025: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
sources.evidence_location: official HTML overview and rounding notice
facts: The page is the November 2025 Project Gigabit management-information release
BDUK publishes contract-level contracted and built premises
The data is rounded to the nearest 10
Numbers may not sum because of rounding
limitations: Rounded contract data is not precise parcel evidence
The release does not establish current service availability

sources.title: December 2025: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
facts: The page is the December 2025 Project Gigabit management-information release
BDUK publishes contract-level progress information
The page was updated on 20 July 2026
The publication is available under the Open Government Licence where stated
limitations: Management progress is not provider orderability
The monthly snapshot cannot be promoted to parcel truth

sources.title: Project Gigabit contracts
sources.evidence_location: official HTML collection description and document list
sources.geography: United Kingdom local and regional contract areas
facts: The collection summarises local and regional Project Gigabit contracts awarded to suppliers
It identifies Project Gigabit as support for hard-to-reach communities
It lists contract pages separately by region
The collection includes Northern Ireland and North East Scotland entries from 2025
limitations: A collection index is lineage evidence rather than completed-build evidence
Listed awards do not prove service at an address

sources.title: Project Gigabit network build contract - Leicestershire and Warwickshire
sources.evidence_location: official HTML May 2026 update and original contract section
facts: The redesigned contract covers around 36,000 premises
The revised investment is up to £76.4 million
The original contract covered around 38,000 premises
The redesign followed expanded commercial rollout and market changes
limitations: Contract scope is not completed deployment
Premises remain subject to detailed planning and technical change
